mapper.select:
SELECT po.id AS sourceId, po.id AS purchaseOrderId, pod.id AS sourceDetailId, pod.id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, pod.warehouse_location AS warehouseLocation, po.code AS purchaseOrderCode, po.delivery_warehouse_name AS deliveryWarehouseName, po.delivery_warehouse_id AS deliveryWarehouseId, pod.sku_id, pod.sku_no,pod.product_name, pod.currency, pod.currency_symbol,pos.supplier_name, pos.supplier_id, pod.tax_price, po.purchase_user_id FROM purchase_order_detail pod LEFT JOIN purchase_order po ON pod.purchase_order_id=po.id AND po.is_deleted=false INNER JOIN purchase_order_supplier pos ON pos.purchase_order_id=po.id AND pos.is_deleted=false WHERE pod.is_deleted=false AND pod.id IN
#{item}

select po.id, pod.id as purchaseDetailId, po.code, pos.supplier_name as supplierName, po.approve_status as approveStatus, po.invalid_status as invalidStatus, pod.execution_status as executionStatus, pod.sku_id as skuId, pod.sku_no as skuNo, pod.product_name as productName, pod.variant_property as variantProperty, pod.plan_delivery_date as planDeliveryDate, pod.is_urgent as isUrgent, po.delivery_warehouse_name as deliveryWarehouseName, pod.tax_price as taxPrice, pod.currency_symbol, pod.purchase_qty as purchaseQty, pod.purchase_amount as purchaseAmount, pod.remark, po.approve_user_name as approveUserName, po.purchase_user_name as purchaseUserName, po.create_user_name as createUserName, po.create_time as createTime, pod.source_detail_id as sourceDetailId from purchase_order po inner join purchase_order_detail pod on po.id = pod.purchase_order_id and pod.is_deleted = false left join purchase_order_supplier pos on po.id = pos.purchase_order_id and pos.is_deleted = false
po.is_deleted = false and po.invalid_status = false
AND pod.source_detail_id IN
#{item}

select psod.bom_version as parentBomVersion, sod.bom_version as childBomVersion, po.id as childPoId, pod.id as childPodId, ppod.id as parentPodId, psod.id as subParentDetailId, psod.sku_id as parentSkuId, so.id as subChildId, so.code as subChildCode, so.approve_status as childApproveStatus, sod.id as subChildDetailId, sod.sku_id as childSkuId, sod.sku_no as childSkuNo, sod.warehouse_id as childWarehouseId, sod.warehouse_location as childWarehouseLocation from purchase_order_detail ppod inner join subcontract_order_detail psod on psod.id = ppod.source_detail_id and ppod.is_deleted = false inner join subcontract_order_detail sod on sod.parent_id = psod.id and sod.is_deleted = false inner join subcontract_order so on sod.main_id = so.id and so.is_deleted = false left join purchase_order_detail pod on pod.source_detail_id = sod.id and pod.is_deleted = false left join purchase_order po on po.id = pod.purchase_order_id and po.is_deleted = false and po.invalid_status = false
psod.is_deleted = false
AND ppod.id IN
#{item}

SELECT DISTINCT po.id, po.code, po.approve_status, pos.supplier_id, pos.supplier_name, pos.supplier_contact_id, po.delivery_warehouse_id AS warehouseId, po.delivery_warehouse_name AS warehouseName, po.create_time, po.purchase_org_id as purchaseOrgId, po.purchase_org_name as purchaseOrgName FROM purchase_order po LEFT JOIN purchase_order_detail pod ON po.id = pod.purchase_order_id AND pod.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN purchase_order_supplier pos on po.id = pos.purchase_order_id AND pos.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE po.is_deleted = FALSE AND po.invalid_status = FALSE AND po.approve_status = 'approve'
AND pod.sku_no = #{skuNo}
AND po.code ILIKE concat('%', #{code}::text ,'%')
ORDER BY po.create_time DESC

SELECT min(po.purchase_date) AS purchaseDate, pod.sku_id FROM purchase_order po INNER JOIN purchase_order_detail pod ON po.id = pod.purchase_order_id AND po.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pod.is_deleted = FALSE AND po.is_first_mass_product = TRUE
AND po.id IN
#{id}
GROUP BY pod.sku_id

SELECT pod.sku_id, pod.sku_no, MAX(po.purchase_date) AS "latestPurchaseDate" FROM purchase_order po LEFT JOIN purchase_order_detail pod ON po.id = pod.purchase_order_id AND pod.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN purchase_order_supplier pos ON po.id = pos.purchase_order_id AND pos.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE po.is_deleted = FALSE and po.type = 'CGDD01_SYS' and po.invalid_status = false and po.approve_status = 'approve' AND purchase_date >= #{purchaseDateList[0]} and purchase_date < #{purchaseDateList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' GROUP BY pod.sku_no ,pod.sku_id

select po.id as id, pod.id as detailId from purchase_order po inner join purchase_order_detail pod on pod.is_deleted = false and po.id = pod.purchase_order_id left join purchase_order_supplier pos on po.id = pos.purchase_order_id and pos.is_deleted = false
po.is_deleted = false and po.approve_status = 'approve' and pod.execution_status = 'toBeConfirm' and
(now() - make_interval(hours => #{item.orderAcceptDTO.duration}::int ) > po.approve_time and pos.supplier_id = #{item.supplierId})
(now() - make_interval(mins => #{item.orderAcceptDTO.duration}::int ) > po.approve_time and pos.supplier_id = #{item.supplierId})
(now() - make_interval(secs => #{item.orderAcceptDTO.duration}::int ) > po.approve_time and pos.supplier_id = #{item.supplierId})

select po.id, pod.id as purchaseDetailId, po.code, pos.supplier_name as supplierName, po.approve_status as approveStatus, po.invalid_status as invalidStatus, pod.execution_status as executionStatus, pod.sku_id as skuId, pod.sku_no as skuNo, pod.product_name as productName, pod.variant_property as variantProperty, pod.plan_delivery_date as planDeliveryDate, pod.is_urgent as isUrgent, po.delivery_warehouse_name as deliveryWarehouseName, pod.tax_price as taxPrice, pod.currency_symbol, pod.purchase_qty as purchaseQty, pod.purchase_amount as purchaseAmount, pod.remark, po.approve_user_name as approveUserName, po.purchase_user_name as purchaseUserName, po.create_user_name as createUserName, po.create_time as createTime, pod.source_detail_id as sourceDetailId from purchase_order po inner join purchase_order_detail pod on po.id = pod.purchase_order_id and pod.is_deleted = false left join purchase_order_supplier pos on po.id = pos.purchase_order_id and pos.is_deleted = false
po.is_deleted = false and po.invalid_status = false
AND pod.id IN
#{item}

select po.id as id, pod.id as detailId from purchase_order po inner join purchase_order_detail pod on pod.is_deleted = false and po.id = pod.purchase_order_id left join purchase_order_supplier pos on po.id = pos.purchase_order_id and pos.is_deleted = false where po.is_deleted = false -- and po.approve_status = 'approve' -- and po.update_time >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' -- and pod.execution_status in ('confirm','delivery')

SELECT count(DISTINCT pod.purchase_order_id) from purchase_order_detail as pod left join purchase_order po on po.id = pod.purchase_order_id and po.is_deleted = false left join purchase_order_supplier pos on po.id = pos.purchase_order_id and pos.is_deleted = false where pod.is_deleted = false and pod.execution_status in ('confirm','delivery') and po.approve_status = 'approve'
and date_part('day', pod.plan_delivery_date::timestamp - CURRENT_DATE::timestamp) < 0
and date_part('day', pod.plan_delivery_date::timestamp - CURRENT_DATE::timestamp) >= 0 and date_part('day', pod.plan_delivery_date::timestamp - CURRENT_DATE::timestamp) <= 7
and date_part('day', pod.plan_delivery_date::timestamp - CURRENT_DATE::timestamp) > 7 and date_part('day', pod.plan_delivery_date::timestamp - CURRENT_DATE::timestamp) <= 30
and date_part('day', pod.plan_delivery_date::timestamp - CURRENT_DATE::timestamp) > 30 and date_part('day', pod.plan_delivery_date::timestamp - CURRENT_DATE::timestamp) <= 60
and date_part('day', pod.plan_delivery_date::timestamp - CURRENT_DATE::timestamp) > 60
and pos.supplier_id = #{supplierId}

SELECT t.supplier_id, t.supplier_name, t.sku_id, t.sku_no, t.supplier_purchase_qty as supplierQty, SUM(t.supplier_purchase_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY t.sku_id) AS skuTotalQty, ROUND( t.supplier_purchase_qty * 1.0 / SUM(t.supplier_purchase_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY t.sku_id), 4 ) AS purchase_ratio FROM ( SELECT pos.supplier_id, pos.supplier_name, pod.sku_id, pod.sku_no, SUM(pod.purchase_qty) AS supplier_purchase_qty FROM purchase_order po INNER JOIN purchase_order_detail pod ON po.ID = pod.purchase_order_id AND pod.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN purchase_order_supplier pos ON po.ID = pos.purchase_order_id AND pos.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE po.is_deleted = FALSE AND po.invalid_status = FALSE AND po.approve_status = 'approve' AND po.create_time < CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY pos.supplier_id, pos.supplier_name, pod.sku_id, pod.sku_no ) t ORDER BY t.sku_id, t.supplier_id;
